purpose: Freeze record for the final generalization test. The classifier files below were hashed BEFORE any final-holdout case was selected; a test recomputes these hashes, so any post-freeze classifier change is loud. finalLabelsSha256 freezes the reviewed expected labels of the final splits before the matcher's single run over them.
ordering: 1. matcher, lexicon, vocabulary and compact mapping frozen and hashed (this file)
2. final holdout cases selected from source structure, WITHOUT running the matcher on them
3. expected labels assigned by human review of the recalled products, then frozen as finalLabelsSha256
4. the matcher run exactly once on the final splits; no classifier or label change afterwards
